h1.en: Why Diesel 30 Concrete Pump Frame Size Is Not Pumping Reach
h1.zh: 为什么柴油30型混凝土泵的外形尺寸不是泵送距离

directAnswer.en: Hebei Pinjin Machinery prints the Diesel 30 Concrete Pump in Xingtai with Dimensions (L×W×H) is 4000 × 1500 × 1800 mm. Main Unit Weight is 2000 kg. Those figures describe the machine body, not the pipeline. Theoretical Output is 15 m³/h and Max. Outlet Pressure is 20 MPa. The frame “Loader (equipment)” shows Wacker Neuson wheel loaders at a trade fair and is not a site measurement of this model.
directAnswer.zh: 河北品锦机械在邢台把柴油30型混凝土泵印成：外形尺寸是4000 × 1500 × 1800 mm。整机重量是2000 kg。这些数字描述的是机身，不是管路。理论输送量是15 m³/h，最大出口压力是20 MPa。画面「Loader (equipment)」的主体是Wacker Neuson wheel 装载机s at a trade fair，不是这个型号的工地实测。

heading.en: Body size and pumping duty use different units
heading.zh: 机身尺寸和泵送工作用的不是同一套单位

body.en: Dimensions (L×W×H) is 4000 × 1500 × 1800 mm. Main Unit Weight is 2000 kg. Millimetres and kilograms do not become metres of pipeline. Distance cells, where the sheet prints them, keep their own labels.
body.zh: 外形尺寸是4000 × 1500 × 1800 mm。整机重量是2000 kg。毫米和千克不会变成管路的米。目录如果另印了距离格，那些格仍用自己的标题。

heading.en: Do not scale the frame into a capacity
heading.zh: 不要把这一帧缩放成产量

body.en: Source: en.wikipedia.org, “Loader (equipment)”. Subject: Wacker Neuson wheel loaders at a trade fair. A wider-looking machine in a frame is not a higher Theoretical Output. The printed output stays 15 m³/h.
body.zh: 来源：en.wikipedia.org，「Loader (equipment)」。主体：Wacker Neuson wheel 装载机s at a trade fair。画面里机器看起来更宽，并不等于理论输送量更高。印出的输送量仍是15 m³/h。

heading.en: Pressure stays in its own cell
heading.zh: 压力留在自己的格子里

body.en: Max. Outlet Pressure is 20 MPa. Hopper Capacity 0.3 m³. Max. Aggregate Size 3 cm and below. Main Unit Weight 2000 kg. None of these is a price, a service life or a country list.
body.zh: 最大出口压力是20 MPa。料斗容积 0.3 m³。最大骨料粒径 3 cm and below。整机重量 2000 kg。这些都不是价格、使用寿命或国家名单。

question.en: What frame text does Diesel 30 Concrete Pump print?
question.zh: 柴油30型混凝土泵的外形文字是什么？

answer.en: Dimensions (L×W×H) is 4000 × 1500 × 1800 mm. Main Unit Weight is 2000 kg.
answer.zh: 外形尺寸是4000 × 1500 × 1800 mm。整机重量是2000 kg。

answer.en: No. Frame figures are body size or mass, not pipeline metres.
answer.zh: 不是。外形数字是机身尺寸或质量，不是管路米数。

question.en: Can the frame's apparent size replace the sheet?
question.zh: 可以用画面里的外观尺寸代替目录吗？

answer.en: No. Use the printed dimension cell, and only if it exists.
answer.zh: 不能。只用已经印出的外形尺寸格。
